SHOP.headline: Cathie Wood's Ark Innovation Fund: Is It Still a Buy After Years of Underperformance?
SHOP.description: The ARK Innovation ETF (ARKK) remains a volatile but potentially rewarding investment option despite mixed recent performance. The fund focuses on emerging technologies including AI, robotics, genomics, and autonomous vehicles, offering low correlation with the S&P 500 and unique diversification benefits. While it may underperform for extended periods, its long-term potential and distinct portfolio composition make it worthy of consideration as a modest allocation in diversified portfolios.

SHOP.headline: Stock Market Today, Aug. 5: Shopify Soars 17% After Beating Q2 Estimates, Raises Q3 Outlook
SHOP.description: Shopify stock surged 17% after delivering strong Q2 earnings with GMV, revenue, gross profits, and free cash flow all growing over 30%. The company raised Q3 guidance and highlighted AI-driven merchant activity, with AI-powered Sidekick assistant usage tripling year-over-year. While trading at elevated multiples (89x FCF, 78x forward earnings), the e-commerce platform continues strong momentum.

AEHR.headline: An Aehr Test Systems Insider Sells Shares Worth $2.5 Million as the Stock Soars. Here's a Closer Look at the Transaction.
AEHR.description: Aehr Test Systems director Geoffrey Gates Scott's spouse sold 20,000 shares worth $2.5 million on July 16, 2026, while 10,000 shares were gifted to the Scott Family Fund. The sale reduced indirect holdings by 40% following a 470% stock surge over the past year. Scott retains over 54,000 shares directly and maintains alignment with shareholders through unvested RSUs. The stock has continued climbing past $100 per share, driven by strong Q4 earnings and increased AI-related semiconductor demand.

PLTR.headline: Peter Thiel Still Owns Roughly 3% of Palantir, a Stake Worth More Than $10 Billion. Here's Why His Continued Conviction Matters for Shareholders.
PLTR.description: Peter Thiel maintains a 3% stake in Palantir Technologies worth over $10 billion and serves as executive chairman, despite selling millions of shares since the company's 2020 IPO. His continued conviction in the data analytics company is viewed as bullish, as Thiel typically liquidates other winning investments. PLTR.headline: AI Trailblazers Nvidia, Palantir, Alphabet, and Meta Are Shaking Wall Street to Its Core With This $3.4 Billion Warning
PLTR.description: Insiders at major AI companies Nvidia, Palantir, Alphabet, and Meta have sold over $3.4 billion in company stock over the trailing 12 months, while making zero purchases. This insider selling activity raises concerns about potential overvaluation and an AI bubble, as insiders typically only buy shares when they believe in future appreciation.

PLTR.headline: Palantir Crushes Earnings in Q2. Is the Stock Heading Back to $200?
PLTR.description: Palantir Technologies delivered strong Q2 earnings with $1.9 billion in revenue (93% YoY growth) and adjusted EPS of 41 cents, both exceeding analyst expectations. The company raised full-year guidance to $8.15-8.158 billion. While the stock has rallied and could potentially reach $200 (24% upside), it trades at over 80x forward earnings, making it expensive despite impressive growth metrics.

BE.headline: Kaplan Fox Encourages Bloom Energy Corporation (NYSE: BE) Investors with Significant Losses to Contact the Firm Before September 28, 2026
BE.description: Kaplan Fox has filed a class action lawsuit against Bloom Energy Corporation for allegedly making false and misleading statements regarding its reliance on Chinese scandium. The complaint alleges that the company obtained scandium through intermediaries sourcing from China but failed to adequately disclose this dependency to investors. The class period covers purchases between February 27, 2025 and July 8, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of September 28, 2026.

BE.headline: Bloom Energy's Pullback Is the Entry Point Long-Term Investors Wanted
BE.description: Bloom Energy stock has declined 37% from its all-time high of $345 to $218, despite delivering its strongest earnings report ever with over $1 billion in revenue for the first time. The company raised 2026 guidance and Wall Street expects revenue to more than triple over the next two years driven by AI data center demand. Trading at 11x forward sales, analysts see 25% upside potential, suggesting the pullback presents a buying opportunity for long-term investors.

BE.headline: Why Big Tech's AI Data Centers Are Turning to Bloom Energy for Power
BE.description: AI data centers are rapidly expanding and require 200 gigawatts of electricity by 2030, but utility companies cannot keep pace. Bloom Energy's hydrogen fuel cell technology is emerging as a solution, offering faster deployment, water-free operation, and quieter performance compared to traditional generators. The company secured a major expansion with Oracle (2.8 gigawatts) and is seeing strong revenue growth driven by customers like Honda, AT&T, and Walmart.
